szene: Late at night in a dark bedroom, Resi sits on the floor leaning against the side of her bed, knees pulled up, her face lit only by the glow of her phone, scrolling with a deadpan expression. Herbert hangs upside down from the bed frame right next to her head, also staring at the screen.

In her bedroom in the early evening, Resi lies on her back on the made bed, fully dressed in her goth outfit and platform boots, holding her phone above her face and typing, completely relaxed. Herbert sits on her stomach looking at her.

At night at a small desk in her room, Resi sits in front of an open laptop, lit by the screen and a desk lamp, surrounded by crumpled paper and empty coffee cups, staring at the screen with tired deadpan eyes. Herbert sleeps curled up next to the laptop.

In her bedroom, Resi lies on her stomach on the bed, propped on her elbows, holding her phone and swiping with a bored deadpan face. Herbert sits on her shoulder and leans forward to look at the phone screen with curiosity.

In a cozy living room late in the evening, Resi has fallen asleep sitting upright on the sofa in a fancy black party dress with perfect makeup, a small handbag still in her lap, platform heels standing neatly on the floor. Herbert sleeps on top of her head.
